svg.title: Lingering: user-service policy after logout.
svg.desc: Two illustrative Linger settings show the user manager may stop after last logout with Linger=no, whereas Linger=yes permits it to run without a logged-in session and start at boot. The read-only command reads this setting on a system using systemd-logind. id -un supplies the current account name through command substitution. Optional administrator-authorized enable and disable commands change this policy; unit enablement is separate. Sleep suspends availability and shutdown stops it.
svg.text: Lingering permits your user manager to run without a login and start at boot.
Reads policy with systemd-logind. $(id -un) inserts your current account name.
manager may stop; services stop too
OPTIONAL policy changes; sudo needs administrator permission:
Sleep suspends availability; shutdown stops it. Unit enable alone is not lingering.
